_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Finding the Light#000.src: Every night, I hear lightning strike the exact same spot. I wonder what it could mean...

Finding the Light#001.src: Most of the pages are filled with religious verses. At the very end of the book, there's a card separate from the rest of the pages.

Finding the Light#002.src: I covered over the way down to that giant archive like you asked. It shouldn't be reachable now.

Finding the Light#003.src: It'd take something really heavy to crack open the foundation- Frankly, that gold church bell might do it if it's not maintained.

Finding the Light#004.src: I left ladders and platforms as access to the bell tower- Make sure you keep it in good condition! I don't want to have to do that kind of work again.

Finding the Light#005.src: What, are you thinking "oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?" IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#005.dst: 怎样，你是在想“噢，我们跟着这个好笑的精灵女孩，看她一次又一次地失败吧！？”是这样吗？！

Finding the Light#006.src: This is enough, Lari. I waken. And thus, your task is complete, {u}. You have done as Orphion asked.

Finding the Light#007.src: What connection does a primordial force have with the moral leanings of mortals- or even immortals?

Finding the Light#008.src: For now, {u} must learn what you have learned, of the nature of realms. They must know what you know if they are to aid you fully.

Finding the Light#009.src: Allow me to show you our reality, {u}. It is difficult to properly present its scale... So here is an approximation.

Finding the Light#010.src: The balance shifts, and Orphion grows weary. Angered, desperate. He called to you as a last plea- and you have done admirably, for what he has asked of you.

Finding the Light#011.src: Enter the portal, {u}. I shall show you the Gateway to Light... And I shall wish you luck.
Finding the Light#011.dst: 进入传送门吧，{u}。我将为你指引光之门户……并祝你好运。

Finding the Light#012.src: What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
Finding the Light#012.dst: 无论在谁看来，你所做的也许都不是正确的事。但那是必要的。从某种意义上说，你挣脱了自己的枷锁。

Finding the Light#013.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#013.dst: 新任务开始：Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light

Finding the Light#014.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#014.dst: 这一下应该把地基震裂了！去看看能不能进入卡片上提到的典藏库。

Finding the Light#015.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#015.dst: 机关已经启动，下面那扇门应该打开了。

Finding the Light#016.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#016.dst: 有几页被撕掉了。在第一处缺页之前，它似乎在描述森林守护者身上发生的事。

Finding the Light#017.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#017.dst: 书的其余部分完好无损——既然典藏库是锁着的，谁会这么做？在你之前有人进来过吗？

Finding the Light#018.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#018.dst: ……于是它回来了，沉睡不醒。光曾预言，守护者终将再次降临于我们面前……

Finding the Light#019.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#019.dst: ……但那一天还在数百年之后，而且需要付出巨大努力。附带的咒语对整个过程至关重要。

Finding the Light#020.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#020.dst: 光也警告过——倘若黑暗侵入并触及守护者的根，它将永远不会醒来……不过看来我们不必担心这一点。

Finding the Light#021.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#021.dst: 这里还有一张散页，上面又是高等 Gavel 文字。Lari 应该能翻译出来。

Finding the Light#022.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#022.dst: ……那就动手吧。看来到目前为止，我在这里只是给你当翻译而已。

Finding the Light#024.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#024.dst: 光之声让你去追她。你现在可不该停下，对吧？

Finding the Light#025.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
Finding the Light#025.dst: 这栋建筑看起来可以爬上去……顺着墙爬上去，也许就能偷听到谈话。

Finding the Light#027.src: You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
Finding the Light#027.dst: 你拿到那株植物了！回到森林守护者身边继续吧。

Finding the Light#028.src: I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
Finding the Light#028.dst: 我不在乎了！别再这样夺走我的人生！！！

Finding the Light#030.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#030.dst: ……啊啊啊啊！！告诉我这怎么就“够了”！现在就告诉我！

Finding the Light#031.src: To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
Finding the Light#031.dst: 你正要说自己做了“黑暗”的事——对此我要说，你没有。

Finding the Light#032.src: For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
Finding the Light#032.dst: 独自思考了一千年甚至更久，我明白你内心充满矛盾。

Finding the Light#033.src: However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
Finding the Light#033.dst: 然而……在那段时间里，你犯了一个严重的错误。你逐渐把一个错误的假设当成了事实。

Finding the Light#034.src: Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
Finding the Light#034.dst: 黑暗与光……彼此对立。彼此冲突。造成令人窒息的疮痍。但请容我问一句。

Finding the Light#035.src: Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
Finding the Light#035.dst: 斧头砍树，斧头就是邪恶的吗？木头抵抗金属，木头就是邪恶的吗？

Finding the Light#036.src: Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
Finding the Light#036.dst: 火焰烧光树叶，火焰就是邪恶的吗？水浇灭火焰，水就是邪恶的吗？

Finding the Light#037.src: Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
Finding the Light#037.dst: 受害者反击伤害他们的人，受害者就是邪恶的吗？

Finding the Light#038.src: And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
Finding the Light#038.dst: 而最重要的是……这些东西里，有哪一样是光，或是暗？

Finding the Light#039.src: I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
Finding the Light#039.dst: 我不会要求你那么做。你必须明白，Orphion 没有道德立场——祂只需要行动。

Finding the Light#040.src: I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
Finding the Light#040.dst: 我承认，这是个难题。我也同意，在许多情况下杀戮是一场悲剧。

Finding the Light#041.src: Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
Finding the Light#041.dst: 可当这样的行为能拯救他人的性命时，它就成了无解的难题。一份无法衡量的分量。

Finding the Light#042.src: Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
Finding the Light#042.dst: 在那样的处境下，你已经尽力了。我无法指责你的想法与道德。

Finding the Light#043.src: And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
Finding the Light#043.dst: 所以……既然你已得到证明，我也已苏醒，通往光的门户将向你显现。Lari……你必须为前往光之领域的旅程做好准备。

Finding the Light#044.src: I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
Finding the Light#044.dst: 我不怪你。等你平复下来，你的伙伴也会准备就绪。要明白，他们和你一样不可或缺。

Finding the Light#045.src: I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
Finding the Light#045.dst: 我必须请你仔细听。我会讲得简单些——尽管此事之重大怎么说都不为过。

Finding the Light#046.src: This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
Finding the Light#046.dst: 这是我们的世界，我们此刻所在的世界。存在的物质位面。

Finding the Light#047.src: Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
Finding the Light#047.dst: 只有极少数人知道，世界远不止于此。就连天文学家和那些仰望浩瀚天空的人也无法理解。

Finding the Light#048.src: For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
Finding the Light#048.dst: 因为，你看，这个领域、这个位面——它映照在第二个位面上，各领域的化身在那里相互冲突。

Finding the Light#049.src: This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
Finding the Light#049.dst: 那是影响位面，由许多领域组成。其中有三个你必须知道——但只有一个需要你特别留意。

Finding the Light#050.src: The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
Finding the Light#050.dst: 影响领域与物质位面相连，彼此紧密相系、无法分割。这就是为什么即便凝望宇宙的人也无法领会它的浩瀚。

Finding the Light#051.src: These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
Finding the Light#051.dst: 这些领域始终在相互推拉——那是这个世界的人看不见的战斗，从未停歇。

Finding the Light#052.src: However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
Finding the Light#052.dst: 然而，它们是能被感受到的。任何一个领域的平衡发生大规模变化，都会反映在物质位面上。

Finding the Light#053.src: The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
Finding the Light#053.dst: 影响领域本身就是巨兽的映像——巨兽是其领域的实体显现，正如领域也是巨兽的显现。

Finding the Light#054.src: So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
Finding the Light#054.dst: 所以你一定明白——既然 Gavel 已经衰败，就意味着光之领域正处于危险之中，Orphion 也是如此。

Finding the Light#055.src: The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
Finding the Light#055.dst: 光被感染了——那只可憎的寄生体已经侵入光之领域，找上 Orphion，要吸走祂的光。

Finding the Light#056.src: And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
Finding the Light#056.dst: 于是，太阳被迫落下，Gavel 的大地日渐昏暗。黑暗的寄生虫蔓延开来，吞噬这里众人的心智，而 Orphion 也在承受同样的折磨。

Finding the Light#057.src: Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
Finding the Light#057.dst: 现在，你必须进入光之领域，协助 Lari 清除那只寄生体，赶在它得逞、Orphion 的心智被吞噬之前。

Finding the Light#058.src: You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
Finding the Light#058.dst: 当然，在此之前你必须做好准备。前往另一个领域可是一项艰巨的任务。

Finding the Light#059.src: I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
Finding the Light#059.dst: 不过，我会赐予你两样东西，它们必定能帮到你。首先，我会为你指出前往光之门户的道路。

Finding the Light#060.src: Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
Finding the Light#060.dst: 等你抵达那里，我会亲自赐予你我的祝福，愿你的道路因此变得清晰。

Finding the Light#062.dst: 苏醒吧！我们需要你的指引！
Finding the Light#062.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#063.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#063.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#064.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#064.dst: 我正在……努力……唤醒森林守护者，以获得它的指引，可它就是一动也不动！就连 Orphion 的声音也唤不起任何反应。
Finding the Light#064.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#065.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#065.dst: 我再求你一次，苏醒吧！我们两个……我们两个在寻求你的智慧！
Finding the Light#065.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#066.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#066.dst: 我献上 Orphion 最微弱的光——请回应吧！
Finding the Light#066.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#067.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can effect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#067.dst: 唔……看到了吧？什么都没发生。我已经不知道该怎么办了。也许你能带来一些改变，毕竟你以前做过那些事。
Finding the Light#067.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#068.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#068.dst: 呃……看到了吧？什么都没发生。我已经不知道该怎么办了。考虑到你之前做过的事，也许你能带来一些改变。
Finding the Light#068.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#069.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#069.dst: 我的脉动，时候到了。我将把我的光洒在守护者的根上。你和她现在必须学习。

Finding the Light#070.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.

Finding the Light#071.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#071.dst: 铭文！之前明明没有的！它……一眨眼就出现了。你到底是怎么……？
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#072.dst: 不过，还是一样！我就知道我能派上用场，让我帮你翻译！你是 Gavel 的外来者，不会懂高等 Gavel 语……
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#073.dst: 上面写着……秘密埋藏于 {p} 最古老的图书馆中。
Finding the Light#073.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#074.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#074.dst: ……果然。一个精灵不准进入、人类却可以进去的地方。{u}，看来你得自己去找这座图书馆了。
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Finding the Light#076.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#076.dst: 想办法爬上教堂顶端的钟楼。

Finding the Light#077.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#077.dst: 探索秘密图书馆，找到唤醒大树的方法。

Finding the Light#079.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#079.dst: 你要拒绝 Orphion 的光吗？请苏醒吧！
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#080.dst: 呃……{u}，请告诉我你有进展。守护者还是不肯……醒……过来！
Finding the Light#080.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#081.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#081.dst: 这是什么？一卷法术卷轴——苏醒森林的卷轴？！偏偏在 {p}？那种我……根本不可能去的地方……
Finding the Light#081.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#082.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#082.dst: 所以我是 Orphion 的天选之人，却做不到被要求做的事。那……不，我不能再想这个，让我看看卷轴。
Finding the Light#082.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#083.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#083.dst: ……嗯。上面写着：寻求者须将这些字句置于守护者的字句之上。
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#084.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#084.dst: 我想那是说你得把它放在铭文旁边。所以又是一件得由你完成的事……
Finding the Light#084.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#085.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#085.dst: ……那就去吧，放上去。看来到目前为止，我在这里只是给你当翻译的。
Finding the Light#085.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#086.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
Finding the Light#086.dst: 对大树底下的铭文施放法术。

Finding the Light#087.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#087.dst: 我也来读读这个吧。恐怕会很繁琐……
Finding the Light#087.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#088.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#088.dst: 上面写着……唤醒森林守护者需要的不只是魔法。精灵的家园将藏有答案与启示……？
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#089.dst: 这……终于轮到我了！我还能参与这件事！！我终于能做的不只是在这里原地维持现状了！
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#090.dst: 听着，{u}。achara……这是我的时刻。我终于能更直接地帮你了。我认识 {p} 的长老们——他们一定会有答案！
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#091.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#091.dst: 即使我一直忧心忡忡，你也真的帮了很大的忙。我必须谢谢你，但你现在可以放松了！这次由我来！
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#092.dst: 你可以继续去做……你需要做的其他事。我看到你在很多地方帮忙——现在先顾好那些事吧。这件事我能处理。
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#093.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#093.dst: 追上她，我的脉动。她必须采取非常手段——单凭她一人，她的光什么都照不亮。你必须为她指引方向。

Finding the Light#094.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind
Finding the Light#094.dst: 进入 Lari 留下的传送门

Finding the Light#095.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.
Finding the Light#095.dst: 前往 Lari 进去的小屋。

Finding the Light#096.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#096.dst: 什、什么？你——你为什么跟着我？我能处理的！我终于能再派上用场了！你……不相信我吗？
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#097.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#097.dst: 请尊重我的意愿！如果我需要你帮忙，我会去找你——现在，请你离开！这件事你不用操心！
Finding the Light#097.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#098.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.

Finding the Light#099.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#099.dst: ……如果这个人类真的做了你说的那些事，你为什么要拒绝他们的帮助？这不像你。
Finding the Light#099.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#100.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#100.dst: 我知道，我知道。我只是难以置信。Orphion 亲自联系了他们，允许他们进入主根，他们还有 Orphion 祝福的象征！！
Finding the Light#100.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#101.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#101.dst: 他们就这么……走过来，在我把整个人生都投入到拯救这个省份整整一千年之后，最多不过几个星期，就做到了我做不到的一切！
Finding the Light#101.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#102.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#102.dst: 你明白这有多让人气愤吗？你没处在我的位置上，能理解这种事吗？
Finding the Light#102.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#103.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#103.dst: 不。我无法理解。但我也无法理解，你为什么不感激这份帮助。
Finding the Light#103.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#104.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#104.dst: 我知道我应该感激！这是我唯一能想的事。我应该欣喜若狂才对！光将得救，这应该就是我梦寐以求的一切……
Finding the Light#104.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#105.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#105.dst: 可是这让我觉得自己彻底失败了。好像我做过的一切都白费了，好像我一直以来不知怎么的全都做错了！
Finding the Light#105.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#106.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#106.dst: 我知道我犯过错。如果我当时行动得快一点，Dullahan 现在还会是……还会是他自己，但我不可能什么都没做对。我无法接受这一点。
Finding the Light#106.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#107.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#107.dst: 这是我证明自己还有用的机会——证明 Orphion 选中我并不是侥幸！拜托，铭文说你会知道该去哪里！
Finding the Light#107.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#109.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#109.dst: ……即使过了一千年，我们所有人要学的东西还多得很。那好吧。
Finding the Light#109.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#110.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#110.dst: 但你要答应我，接受别人给你的帮助。这个机会不能浪费，Lari。
Finding the Light#110.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#111.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#111.dst: ……我至少得做对一件事。我不能一直这样原地踏步下去。无论需要做什么，我都会去做！
Finding the Light#111.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#112.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#112.dst: 那么你必须去寻找 Canned Abis 这种植物。它生长在一个被巨大蕨叶遮蔽的洞穴里。
Finding the Light#112.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#113.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#113.dst: 谢谢你。我终于能做我该做的事了！这次我不会让任何东西阻止我！！
Finding the Light#113.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#114.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#114.dst: ……人类，我看得到你。算你走运，她没看到。过来跟我谈谈。
Finding the Light#114.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#116.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#116.dst: 原来你就是 Orphion 新的天选之人。这既令人意外，又在意料之中——人类的名声很耐人寻味。
Finding the Light#116.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#117.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#117.dst: 人们常说你们什么事都办得成，毫无底线，不管是完成不可能的任务，还是打破道德准则。
Finding the Light#117.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#118.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#118.dst: 然而这一次，这两件事你都得做。这是 Orphion 的命令，不是吗？所以你必须去做，为此我向你道歉。
Finding the Light#118.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#119.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#119.dst: 我见过 Lari 的付出——她为这片土地做出了无价的贡献。她独自一人阻止了衰败向南蔓延，守护者才得以留在我们身边。
Finding the Light#119.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#120.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#120.dst: 然而，她自己的道德观让情况无法推进。她不能杀生——而源头必须被消灭，光才能再次充满这片土地。
Finding the Light#120.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#121.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#121.dst: Orphion 的处境岌岌可危——所以你必须明白一件事。在道德上，他凌驾于我们之上。那种概念并不适用于他。
Finding the Light#121.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#122.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#122.dst: 身为光本身的化身，他没有道德观——只有生存与维持。他对我们的要求，很多人都会退缩。
Finding the Light#122.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#123.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#123.dst: 这件事必须把道德放在一边……而这正是 Lari 无法忍受的，因为一千年来她一直固执地坚守着道德。
Finding the Light#123.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#124.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#124.dst: 要打破它们……我承认，我相信还有别的办法能解决这些问题，但事实是，已经没有时间了。
Finding the Light#124.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#125.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#125.dst: 她必须发挥她全部的力量，而只要她还坚持不杀生，这就不会发生。我必须请你跟着她，就如 Orphion 所愿。
Finding the Light#125.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#126.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#126.dst: 很遗憾，这件事没有对错可言。只有必要——而在那里，你必须把她逼到极限。去寻找 Canned Abis 的洞穴吧。
Finding the Light#126.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#127.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#127.dst: 它在这里的东北边。入口被巨大的蕨叶遮蔽着。我只祈祷这样就足够了。
Finding the Light#127.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#128.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#128.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Canned Abis 洞穴

Finding the Light#129.src: Find the plant inside the cave.
Finding the Light#129.dst: 在洞穴里找到那株植物。

Finding the Light#131.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#131.dst: ……我真不敢相信。我到底哪里做错了？是什么？一定有原因的，到底是什么？！
Finding the Light#131.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#132.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by "dire actions?!" I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#132.dst: 没有新的铭文……还是同样的字句！“非常手段”到底是什么意思？！我想得到的办法全都试过了！
Finding the Light#132.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#133.src: ...{u}. I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#133.dst: ……{u}。我。我必须知道。Orphion 到底跟你说了什么？我再也受不了什么都不知道了。祂真的取代我了吗？

Finding the Light#134.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#134.dst: 难、难道这还不够非常吗？我埋头钻研你，把我的职责和尊严让给别人，这样还不够极端吗？！
Finding the Light#134.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#135.src: .... I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#135.dst: ……我。我必须知道。Orphion 到底跟你说了什么？我再也受不了什么都不知道了。他真的把我换掉了吗？
Finding the Light#135.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#136.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#136.dst: 我想不出还有什么其他原因，能让我做的一切都……不管用了。是这样吗？求你，告诉我——
Finding the Light#136.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#137.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#137.dst: ……等等……你……你身上有 Canned Abis！！你从哪里弄来的？！
Finding the Light#137.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#138.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#138.dst: 你……除非你……否则你不可能知道……是你！你偷听了我说话！！
Finding the Light#138.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#139.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#139.dst: 我都叫你别跟了，你还跟着我进了洞穴！你……在我说了那么多之后！！在你听到那些私密的心事之后！
Finding the Light#139.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#140.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#140.dst: 你还是觉得跟过来是个好主意！你这样到底想做成什么？！
Finding the Light#140.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#142.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#142.dst: 那时候你都听到了！！全都摊开了！我成功不了！有你在！你在做我做不到的一切！
Finding the Light#142.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#143.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#143.dst: 我不是失败者！我不是！我不会是！我拒绝当失败者！轮不到你来看我手忙脚乱地挣扎！！
Finding the Light#143.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#146.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#146.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#149.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS ‘’ENOUGH!‘’ TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#149.dst: ……啊啊啊啊啊！！告诉我这怎么就“够了”！告诉我，现在就说！
Finding the Light#149.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#150.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#150.dst: 我、我差点杀了他们！我刚刚打破并玷污了我坚守的一切！！
Finding the Light#150.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#151.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#151.dst: 告诉我！！这怎么可能是答案？！这怎么可能是必须发生的事？！
Finding the Light#151.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#152.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#152.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#153.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#153.dst: 因、因为他们做到了我做不到的事就想杀了他们，这还不算黑暗？你怎么可能这么想？！
Finding the Light#153.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#154.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#154.dst: 你算什么守护者，竟然容许这种暴力？我刚才做的事哪一点是可以的？
Finding the Light#154.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#155.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#155.dst: ……你。你不可能是在说我做的事是对的。我拒绝接受。
Finding the Light#155.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#157.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#157.dst: ……那么……我不是应该觉得……我也不知道。我不是应该觉得不那么受束缚？不那么害怕？更……更自由吗？
Finding the Light#157.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#158.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#158.dst: 如果我做的事是必须发生的，为什么我觉得自己像世上最卑劣的人渣？为什么我感觉这么糟？！
Finding the Light#158.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#159.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#159.dst: ……我……我需要时间消化这件事。我……你明白听到这种话有多难吗？承受起来有多难？
Finding the Light#159.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#160.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
Finding the Light#160.dst: 我的脉动，你的光辉煌灿烂……它照耀了 Lari，很快她的光也将照向我……

Finding the Light#161.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
Finding the Light#161.dst: 进入树根，见证通往我领域的道路。然后，做好准备。汇聚你最耀眼的光……
